set.body: See docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md, V1. Resolve configured projects or explicit remote roots; pin target and expanded root; scope job/event membership using explicit context or recorded cwd, never job-name guesses. Expose bounded local-only workspace CLI/Python/core MCP snapshot and cursor reads with independent cursors, per-section coverage and health. Reuse activity queries and semantic/attention models. Test offline/no-SSH reads, alias/root changes, overlapping projects, unmapped work, history gaps and cross-client parity.
set.title: V1: workspace identity and shared snapshot/delta API
